subheading: Two years building production software before grad school.

items.summary: Built and maintained a modular SaaS platform for AB-InBev warehouse operations, serving 1,000+ daily users.
highlights: Built a modular SaaS platform (Angular + FastAPI + PostgreSQL) serving 1,000+ daily users across 4+ microservices and 20+ REST endpoints, with SKU/shelf management and 3D planogram visualization via Three.js, deployed on Azure behind a load balancer with Docker across dev, pre-prod, and prod.
Built an AI chatbot (FastAPI + OpenAI API) grounded in PostgreSQL lookups and document retrieval, letting warehouse staff query inventory in natural language and cutting manual lookup time by 60%.
Streamed real-time sensor telemetry over WebSockets into Chart.js dashboards for proactive environmental alerting across facilities.
Automated data collection and reporting pipelines via cron jobs and Python scripts against PostgreSQL, delivering scheduled analytics with zero manual handoff.

items.summary: Shipped a full product backend from zero to production in under six months.
highlights: Designed 15 MongoDB collections from scratch using an embedded-document pattern, backing 35+ REST endpoints across bookings, billing, subscriptions, and catalog; shipped from zero to production in under 6 months and onboarded 50+ users in the first month.
Implemented JWT auth with inactivity expiry in httpOnly cookies, CORS origin whitelisting, and server-side validation on every request, reducing auth-related bugs by 40%.
Automated 4 GitHub Actions pipelines deploying Dockerized containers to AWS ECS (EC2 + ALB) with IAM-scoped roles, cutting release cadence from weekly to every 3 days.
Built the admin portal and customer-facing site in React/Node.js/Express, with Redis caching and a CloudFront CDN over S3, and Lambda handling background jobs.

items.summary: Digitized paper-based manufacturing workflows from scratch.
highlights: Replaced a paper-based invoice workflow with a React/Node.js/MySQL application handling line items, tax calculations, and PDF generation for 50 daily shop-floor users.
Built a 5-state gauge lifecycle manager with state-transition validation, compliance tracking, and CSV export, replacing a fully manual paper process.
Implemented automated PDF report generation for invoices and gauge compliance.

items.summary: Tuned .NET Core APIs and built React components for device-management products.
highlights: Added pagination, fuzzy search, and composite indexes to .NET Core REST APIs backed by MSSQL, cutting average response time from 500ms to 250ms across device-management endpoints.
Built mobile-responsive React components (admin panels, device state views, connected-device dashboards) with Google Tag Manager analytics across 3 customer-facing modules.
Wrote Jest component tests across the frontend, raising coverage from 62% to 79% and reducing post-deployment bugs by 20%.
